source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned task file declares8editor actions with command strings that point to ../mach. Run Test uses command ../mach and arguments test and $ZED_FILE. The file declares no working directory, so successful invocation still depends on the editor's working-directory and variable-expansion contracts, which were not paired or run here. This is scoped configuration evidence, not a build/run guarantee or a global editor convention.
title: The Zed task file calls the parent mach command and passes the current file to test
